_note: Data-driven live-DTR policy registry. SCOPE: criteria-lifting (dtrCriteriaFromReview) is now generic across QUANTITATIVE gates — age, BMI + obesity band, and any measure mapping to a standard LOINC concept (BP, weight, height, HbA1c, glucose, eGFR, LDL/HDL/total-chol/triglycerides, LVEF — the MEASURE_LOINC set), each evaluated from the patient record through the SHARED three-valued engine (evalMeasure), honouring the policy's boolean tree (OR-branches are non-required), unit compatibility (a cross-unit reading is a gap, never a wrong met), exclusions/negation, and between-inclusivity. A measure with no standard coded concept (stenosis%, tumour size) surfaces as a documentation gap, not a silent drop. So 'add a row + a PDF, no new code' now works for any policy whose computable gates are LOINC-mapped quantitative measures. REMAINING (tracked follow-ups, same list as the policyRegistry.ts SCOPE note): a full BoolExpr verdict (distinct OR-pools evaluated independently), multi-pathway population gating, coverage-EXCLUSION denial in this group view, the needs-info vs not-met distinction (collapsed to a gap today), sustainedOver/temporal windows (evaluated on a point reading today), and per-group policy-version provenance. Adding a supported policy = a row here + its PDF under public/sample-policies + (only if it needs a new sample patient) a bundle key in PATIENT_BUNDLES in policyRegistry.ts. evaluateLivePolicy still FAILS LOUD (throws) for a registered code whose lifted criteria carry no valid gate. NOTE: CG-SURG-83 is an Elevance/Anthem COMMERCIAL guideline used as an exemplar; a state-Medicaid arrangement would enumerate its own criteria.
